items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: Well of course. And they hate each other so, it’s too bad.

ctx.x: No. Well you know your opinion, plus I’ve never seen Garfunkel live. I think of him with Simon.
Well of course. And they hate each other so, it’s too bad. It’s a terrible thing. And they’re going out on tour and they probably won’t even talk to each other.
